(Japanese culture is renowned for its meticulous etiquette, respect systems, and unwavering politeness in daily interactions. Swiss culture ranks highly for punctuality, cleanliness, and civil conduct. Brazilian culture excels in warmth, hospitality, and social ease, though it can be more relaxed or informally expressive in mannerisms compared to the other two.)
